objectives_fil: Magmungkahi ng isang trial na tumutugon sa natiyak na sanhi, may owner, resources, deadline, sukatan at petsa ng review, na may pagsang-ayon ng katuwang.
objectives_en: Recommend a trial addressing a verified cause, with an owner, resources, deadline, measure and review date, subject to partner agreement.

sections.takeaway_fil: Paghambingin ang solusyon ayon sa sanhi at resources, hindi sa dali lamang ng paggawa.
sections.takeaway_en: Compare solutions against the cause and resources, not convenience alone.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang rekomendasyon ay nagiging plano kapag may responsable, resources, petsa at sukatan ng resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: A recommendation becomes a plan when it names an owner, resources, date and outcome measure.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang solusyon ay may may-ari at kasosyo; hindi lahat ng gawain ay ibinabagsak sa BHW.
sections.takeaway_en: Solutions need owners and partners; not every task belongs to the BHW.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang review ay pagkakataong baguhin ang palagay at plano gamit ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Review uses results to revise assumptions and the plan.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang plano ay may taong kikilos at paraan upang malaman kung bumaba ang hadlang.
sections.takeaway_en: A plan names who acts and how to tell whether the barrier decreased.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang plano ay may taong kikilos at paraan upang malaman kung bumaba ang hadlang.
sections.takeaway_en: A plan names who acts and how to tell whether the barrier decreased.

check.prompt_fil: Nagawa ang meeting ngunit hindi dumami ang nakarating. Ano ang tamang review?
check.prompt_en: The meeting happened but attendance did not improve. What review is useful?

options.fil: Ituring na tagumpay dahil natapos ang meeting.
options.en: Declare success because the meeting finished.

options.fil: Ulitin ang parehong plano nang walang bagong tanong.
options.en: Repeat the same plan without new questions.

options.fil: Balikan ang hadlang at ihambing ang invitations at attendance bago magbago.
options.en: Recheck barriers and compare invitations with attendance before revising.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikatlong sagot ay sumusukat sa resulta. Ang meeting ay gawain, hindi patunay na nawala ang hadlang; ang basta pag-uulit ay maaaring maulit ang maling palagay.
check.feedback_en: The third response examines results. A meeting is an activity, not proof that a barrier disappeared; repetition may preserve the wrong assumption.
